notes: 默认工作区的「会话」纳入同步，「资料」仍各机独立：以前默认工作区整个跳过（会话目录名由本机 WorkspaceHome 绝对路径编码，跨机不同会留死目录）。这次只同步它的会话——capture 把默认工作区会话目录写成跨机稳定名 --default-workspace--，会话头 cwd 归一到 {{WORKSPACE_HOME}}/default-workspace；apply 按本机 workspace.json 的 defaultWorkspaceId 反查本机默认工作区路径，重编码会话目录名、改会话头 cwd、对齐 projcache、并把会话 id 并入本机默认工作区登记。资料不同步：capture 按 defaultWorkspaceId 跳过默认工作区资料拷贝，但 workspace-registry.json 里的登记条目保留（会话归属需要）。普通工作区、im、其余机制与勾选过滤全部不变。selftest 加 10 条断言防回归。保留 0.3.93-0.3.97 全部修复。
notesEn: Default workspace conversations now sync; its files stay local: previously the whole default workspace was skipped (its session directory name is encoded from the local WorkspaceHome absolute path, which differs across machines and leaves a dead directory). Now only its conversations sync — capture writes the default-workspace session directory under a cross-machine stable name --default-workspace-- and normalizes the session header cwd to {{WORKSPACE_HOME}}/default-workspace; apply resolves the local default workspace path from this machine's workspace.json global.defaultWorkspaceId, re-encodes the session directory name, fixes the header cwd, aligns projcache, and merges the session ids into the local default workspace registry entry. Files stay local: capture skips default-workspace file copying by defaultWorkspaceId, but keeps its registry entry (needed for session ownership). Normal workspaces, im, all other mechanics and scope filters unchanged. 10 selftest assertions added. Keeps all 0.3.93-0.3.97 fixes.
